conventions.target: log residual of the UNCHANGED incumbent Gate-2 guarantee prediction; if arbitration carries information the FA model lacks, it must appear here
conventions.protocol: fa_backtest.run_market_gate(persist=False, persist_dpw=False) over its own forward-chained winters, paired row by row via GATE2_COLLECT
conventions.feature: arb_resid: our own out-of-fold arbitration residual, orthogonal by construction to the arb model's features

loss_ledger.claim: arbitration history adds information to the free-agent market model
loss_ledger.statement: The arbitration block is a NULL on the free-agent market gate. Its incremental contribution to the incumbent Gate-2 guarantee residual is not separable from a placebo permuted within class year. The raw correlation between arbitration salary and the first free-agent guarantee is real and large, and it is fully accounted for by the production both quantities measure, which the incumbent model already reads through its projected-WAR and rational-anchor terms. fa_market is UNCHANGED.
